# Email Authentication Checker

> Free SPF, DKIM, DMARC and BIMI checker: paste any domain and get a plain-English report on why your email might be going to spam, with the exact DNS record read and what it means. Nothing uploaded -- your browser queries public DNS directly.

Free to use and source available (FSL-1.1-MIT). It reads a domain's public DNS records and explains what they say under RFC 7208 (SPF), RFC 6376 and RFC 8301 (DKIM) and RFC 7489 (DMARC); it cannot see your mail server, your sent mail or a receiver's own filtering, so it is evidence about DNS, not a deliverability guarantee.
